INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]) , 'TSK_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE' TASK_NAME,'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
